description: A portfolio seen through its funds: each ETF or mutual fund opened into the positions of its latest SEC N-PORT and added to the stocks held directly, giving the real exposure to each company, the overlap between funds and the effective number of positions.

symbol.description: A stock (AAPL) or a fund or ETF (VOO, QQQ, AGG, FXAIX).

weight.description: Its weight or its value: weights are rescaled to sum to 1.

top.description: Most look-through positions to list; default 25.

name: portfolio_xray

outputSchema.description: rows are issuers by look-through weight, in the order of columns; via splits each by the holding it comes through.

title: Portfolio X-ray (look-through)
